meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次代码改动做成一集讲解视频,讲清改了什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要向非技术的同事解释改了什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a short explainer video of what changed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must explain code changes to non-technical teammates

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一个 GitHub PR 做成代码改动的讲解视频:读取 diff、提交和文件,规划分镜与脚本,逐帧构建,最终产出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N 等指代,或在已 checkout 的仓库里说「this PR」时触发。它面向代码改动,不是网站,也不做产品宣传或无 PR 的选题讲解。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成讲解视频:acme/sdk#1842
say.note: 会先抓取该 PR 的 diff 与提交

say.text: 用 this PR 做一个修复讲解视频
say.note: 在已 checkout 的仓库里可直接这样指代

say.text: 这个 PR 用 feature reveal 的角度讲解
say.note: 分镜方案会先给你确认

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude turns a GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video: it reads the diff, commits, and files, plans the storyboard and script, builds the frames, and outputs renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo. It covers code changes, not websites, and is not for product promos or no-PR explainers.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: acme/sdk#1842
say_en.note: It fetches the PR's diff and commits first

say_en.text: Make a fix-explainer video for this PR
Explain this PR as a feature reveal
say_en.note: You approve the plan before frames are built
